problem: An executor Waker::wake panic escaped the database worker operation boundary, terminating its thread and leaving unrelated already accepted Response futures pending indefinitely.
fix: Catch unwinding wake notifications after publishing the completed result and releasing its mutex. Keep draining the bounded queue using the existing connection.
reproduction: Blocked first operation guarantees a panicking waker is registered before publication; second queued operation times out on old production source. The failure log records the wake panic and TimedOut instead of Ok(2).
regression_cases: Retained first response, open admission: first result and queued SQL commit survive; a later request succeeds.
Retained first response, closed admission: accepted operations drain; first result is preserved.
Canceled first response, open admission: accepted first SQL operation still commits; queued and later operations succeed.
Canceled first response, closed admission: dropping the store and future cannot strand already accepted SQL work.
